questions.question: gstack works best when your project's CLAUDE.md includes skill routing rules. Add them now?

options.label: Add routing rules to CLAUDE.md (Recommended)
options.description: Creates CLAUDE.md in the project root with gstack skill routing rules so Claude knows when to invoke each skill automatically. One-time setup, committed to git.

options.label: No thanks, I'll invoke skills manually
options.description: Skip CLAUDE.md setup — you'll continue invoking skills with /slash commands when needed.

questions.question: No design doc found for this branch. /office-hours produces a structured problem statement, premise challenge, and explored alternatives — sharper input for the review. Run it first or proceed with standard review?

options.label: Skip — proceed with standard review (Recommended)
options.description: The plan is detailed enough (77 lines, clear scope, existing contracts documented) to run the full review pipeline now. /office-hours adds value for exploratory or ambiguous plans.

options.label: Run /office-hours first
options.description: Produces a structured design doc with premise challenge and alternatives before the review starts. Adds ~10 min but sharpens the CEO phase significantly.
